part.text:
Built a static site generator CLI at `/tmp/story_21dda1e92cf6`:

- **`src/types.ts`** — shared types (`Page`, `PageFrontmatter`, `BuildOptions`)
- **`src/markdown.ts`** — parses frontmatter via `gray-matter` and renders Markdown via `marked`, normalizing `date`/`tags`
- **`src/templates.ts`** — HTML templates for pages and the index, with HTML-escaping
- **`src/build.ts`** — recursively reads `./content`, converts each `.md` to HTML in `./dist` (mirroring subdirectories), writes `index.html` sorted newest-first, and a stylesheet
- **`src/cli.ts`** — arg parsing (`build`, `--content <dir>`, `--output <dir>`) and `main()`
- **`bin/ssg.js`** — the `npx ssg build` entrypoint (uses `ts-node/register` so it runs the TS source directly)
- Sample content in `./content/` (`hello-world.md`, `about.md`)
- Full jest test suite across all four modules (parsing, templates, build pipeline with temp dirs, CLI arg parsing/execution)
